deliverables: Essential Oura codebase maintenance including dependency updates, Cardano protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, and documentation.
Community support including issue triage, review of external contributions, ecosystem-feedback-driven enhancements, and public communication.
Upgrade Oura compatibility with AI-driven development workflows through AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
Use Intersect treasury management smart contracts with milestone-based disbursement controls and reporting obligations.
request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, for project-specific administration on behalf of TxPipe/Oura
request.what: Fund 12 months of part-time maintenance for Oura by TxPipe, including maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation/integration resources.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Oura maintenance and enhancement and a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The maintenance funding is described as 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
Oura is described as a Rust-native pipeline tool that connects to Cardano nodes, monitors blockchain events, and routes matching patterns to pluggable outputs.

The document states Oura supports multiple data sources including N2C, N2N, S3, Mithril, and UTxO RPC, and many sinks including Kafka, Elasticsearch, AWS services, RabbitMQ, Redis, SQL databases, and webhooks.
The proposer states Oura has 654 commits, 288 stars, 79 forks, and 58 contributors, and is the most starred project in the TxPipe portfolio.
The proposer states Oura has been funded twice through Project Catalyst, in Fund 9 and Fund 13, for feature development.
The proposer states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 successfully delivered and 4 currently under development and on schedule.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
The document states independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA to maintain Oura for 12 months through Intersect-administered smart contracts, citing Oura's technical role, open-source adoption metrics, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and oversight controls.
